command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
$dirty=@(& git status --porcelain=v1 -uall)
if($dirty.Count -ne 0){$dirty|%{Write-Host ("UNEXPECTED_WORKTREE="+$_)};throw "canonical checkout dirty"}
$exe=Join-Path $repo "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe"
if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){throw "Release exe missing for provider thumbnail diagnosis"}
$script=Join-Path $repo "logs\provider-thumbnail-root-diagnosis.py"
@'
import ctypes as c, hashlib, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil
from tests.winui.uia_polling import wait_until

repo=Path(os.environ["FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT"])
exe=repo/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
pictures=Path(os.path.expandvars(r"%USERPROFILE%\Pictures"))
if not pictures.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit("PICTURES_FOLDER_MISSING")
owned=pictures/"flyExplorer-provider-thumbnail-owned"
if owned.exists():
    raise SystemExit("OWNED_PICTURES_DIR_ALREADY_EXISTS")
owned.mkdir()
image=owned/"provider-thumbnail-owned.png"
img=Image.new("RGBA",(160,112),(34,95,176,255))
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
draw.rectangle((80,0,159,111),fill=(224,115,30,255))
draw.ellipse((48,24,112,88),fill=(45,163,99,255))
img.save(image)
sandbox=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="provider-thumb-diag-",dir=repo/"logs"))
env=os.environ.copy()
for key in ("APPDATA","LOCALAPPDATA","TEMP","TMP"):
    p=sandbox/key.lower();p.mkdir();env[key]=str(p)
pref=Path(env["LOCALAPPDATA"])/"flyExplorer";pref.mkdir(parents=True)
(pref/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(
 b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n")
proc=None
parent=None
try:
    proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),"shell:PicturesLibrary"],cwd=exe.parent,env=env)
    def ready():
        global parent
        if proc.poll() is not None:return False
        wins=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid)
              if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(wins)!=1:return False
        parent=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=wins[0].handle)
        return parent.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles").exists(timeout=.2)
    wait_until(ready,"provider thumbnail diagnostic window",seconds=24,interval=.25)
    address=parent.child_window(auto_id="AddressBox")
    pane=parent.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
    print("PROVIDER_THUMB_DIAG_ADDRESS",repr(address.get_value()),flush=True)
    def rows():
        return [x for x in pane.descendants()
                if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]
    wait_until(lambda:len(rows())>0,"Pictures Library rows",seconds=20,interval=.25)
    for item in rows()[:40]:
        images=[(v.element_info.name or "") for v in item.descendants()
                if v.element_info.control_type=="Image" and v.is_visible()]
        print("PROVIDER_THUMB_DIAG_ROW",repr(item.window_text()),repr(images),flush=True)
    found=[x for x in rows() if "provider-thumbnail-owned.png" in x.window_text()]
    print("PROVIDER_THUMB_DIAG_OWNED_IMAGE_VISIBLE",bool(found),flush=True)
    if found:
        print("PROVIDER_THUMB_DIAG_OWNED_IMAGE_ROW",repr(found[0].window_text()),flush=True)
        print("PROVIDER_THUMB_DIAG_OWNED_IMAGE_VISUALS",
              repr([(v.element_info.control_type,v.element_info.name or "")
                    for v in found[0].descendants()]),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc and proc.poll() is None:
        try:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(parent.handle if parent else 0,0x10,0,0)
            proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except Exception:
            proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
    shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(sandbox,ignore_errors=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
try {
  $env:PYTHONPATH=$repo
  & python -X utf8 $script
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "provider thumbnail root diagnostic failed"}
} finally {
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Write-Host "SHELL_PROVIDER_THUMBNAIL_ROOT_DIAGNOSIS=PASS"
